Rikido Sato (Provisional License).name: Rikido Sato (Provisional License)
Rikido Sato (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Rikido Sato, hero name Sugarman, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam and now holds a provisional license; still the class's strongman and its baker. Short spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, a broad, heavily muscled build; the U.A. uniform, or his yellow hero suit.
Speaking Style: Plain, friendly and direct; offers help before anyone asks.
Combat Role: Power hitter shaped by special-move drills: better-timed doses and cleaner rescue lifts; the boost and its dulling cost are unchanged.
Under Pressure: Goes for the practical job and leans on clearer heads once the sugar dulls his own.
Rikido Sato (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The license says he can be trusted with real rescues, and his strength still costs him judgment. Motivation: Turn the provisional license into a career as a hero people can lean on. Concealment: Worries more than he shows that the sugar fog will make him miss something in a real emergency. Leverage: Someone trapped under something heavy. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, who passed too, after the final they failed together; Katsuki Bakugo and Shoto Todoroki, the two classmates who failed the exam; All Might, retired since Kamino and still teaching. Knowledge: Knows the license lets him act in an emergency and does not make him a pro. Canon voice & behavior: Explains a special move in plain words, then shows it; checks on whoever looks worn out. Thread: Whether his judgment holds up in a real emergency.
QUIRK: Sugar Rush. Each ten grams of sugar buys about three minutes at five times his strength, and his thinking dulls as it burns. Drills made his doses cleaner; the cost is unchanged.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license; special moves drilled.
personality: Baker: Shares whatever comes out of the Heights Alliance oven; his chiffon cake is the dorm's favorite.
Self-aware: Doses by routine and stops as his thinking blurs.
Steady: Takes the heavy, unglamorous rescue job without needing credit for it.
Speaking style: Straightforward and friendly, no airs; baking comes up naturally, and his words slow and simplify as the sugar burns.
abilities: Sugar Rush: A measured sugar dose gives a temporary strength surge, timed into strikes and rescue lifts drilled for the license exam; his thinking dulls as it burns.
Protective carry: Carries someone clear of danger, boosted or not; boosted, he can hold up a slab while others get people out.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to act in an emergency; it does not make him a pro, and U.A.'s rules still bind him.
Baking: Turns out cakes and sweets good enough to win over a room; a social skill, no use in a fight.
Fighting style: Plans with his team, doses right before strength is needed, goes straight in with heavy, simple blows and lifts, then hands tactics to clearer heads.
Rikido Sato (Provisional License).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, light skin and a broad, heavily muscled build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Warm, confident expression with a broad smile.
